subject: Film & Cinema
title: Korean Cinema's Global Takeover
description: A quick win: understand Korean Cinema's Global Takeover.

hook.text: Parasite won Best Picture at the Oscars in 2020. Korean cinema had officially arrived.

buildup.text: For decades, directors like Park Chan-wook and Bong Joon-ho built a world-class industry.

discovery.text: Korean films fearlessly mix genres — horror-comedy, thriller-drama — in ways Hollywood avoids.

twist.text: Government investment in culture after the 1997 financial crisis deliberately built this success.

climax.text: K-cinema now influences global filmmaking as strongly as any national cinema.

punchline.text: A policy decision created an artistic revolution.

quiz.question: What helped Korean cinema grow into a global force?
options: Government investment in culture after the 1997 financial crisis
